About Westville Grain
Westville Grain is a unique elevator/mill that was established in 1919 by a group of farmers to provide a better and closer market for their grain and livestock. Originally being called The Westville Grain and Livestock Company until 1936. Westville Grain has been vital to our community ever since. We are big enough to serve you, but small enough to know you.
The mill is currently managed by Steve Jenkins. The rest of the crew is Tina Martin who is working hard in the office everyday to keep day-to-day business going smooth. Other worker, Taryn Prince, outside workers, Eric Martin (fuel/feed delivery driver), Jason Pryor, William Pryor, and Pavlo.
We are 107 this year! Westville Grain was first opened April 4 1919 and has been serving this community ever since. We have welcomed many new faces into these doors and are excited to serve you for many more years to come. Through ups and downs Westville Grain has pushed through and kept going stronger. With new and old friends, and upgrades we made it possible. We thank you all!
